nodes.description: UE is in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
UE has sent REGISTRATION REQUEST and is waiting for a response (Timer T3510 running).
UE has received REGISTRATION ACCEPT requiring acknowledgement and is preparing/sending REGISTRATION COMPLETE.
UE is successfully registered with the network (5GMM-REGISTERED state).
UE registration attempt was rejected by the network or failed due to maximum retries or other failures.
AMF is idle with respect to this UE's registration procedure.
AMF has received REGISTRATION REQUEST and is processing it (e.g., performing authentication, security).
AMF has sent REGISTRATION ACCEPT requiring acknowledgement and is waiting for REGISTRATION COMPLETE (Timer T3550 running).
AMF considers the UE successfully registered (5GMM-REGISTERED state).
REGISTRATION REQUEST message is sent by UE / received by AMF.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message requiring REGISTRATION COMPLETE is sent by AMF / received by UE.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message not requiring REGISTRATION COMPLETE is sent by AMF / received by UE.
REGISTRATION REJECT message is sent by AMF / received by UE.
REGISTRATION COMPLETE message is sent by UE / received by AMF.
UE's T3510 timer expires before receiving a response, and retry counter is less than 5.
UE's T3510 timer expires, and retry counter reaches 5.
AMF's T3550 timer expires (1st to 4th time) while waiting for REGISTRATION COMPLETE.
AMF's T3550 timer expires for the 5th time while waiting for REGISTRATION COMPLETE.
Abnormal case occurs at the UE side (e.g., lower layer failure, TAI change).
Abnormal case occurs at the AMF side (e.g., lower layer failure).

edges.description: Triggered by UE initiating initial registration by sending REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
Transition occurs after UE sends REGISTRATION REQUEST and starts timer T3510.
Triggered by AMF receiving a REGISTRATION REQUEST message from the UE.
Transition occurs when AMF receives the REGISTRATION REQUEST and starts processing it, potentially initiating common procedures.

Triggered by AMF accepting the registration and sending REGISTRATION ACCEPT that requires a REGISTRATION COMPLETE response (e.g., due to GUTI reallocation, SOR container, Operator-defined access category definitions, CAG info, UE radio capability ID, PEIPS info, NSAG info, NSSAI update, On-demand NSSAI, Alternative NSSAI, Truncated 5G-S-TMSI config, Service-level-AA pending).
Transition occurs after AMF sends REGISTRATION ACCEPT requiring COMPLETE and starts timer T3550.
Triggered by AMF accepting the registration and sending REGISTRATION ACCEPT that does not require a REGISTRATION COMPLETE response.
Transition occurs after AMF sends REGISTRATION ACCEPT not requiring COMPLETE; AMF enters registered state.
Triggered by AMF rejecting the registration request due to various reasons (e.g., congestion, not allowed, no slices available).
Transition occurs after AMF sends REGISTRATION REJECT.
Triggered by UE receiving a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message that requires a REGISTRATION COMPLETE response.
Transition occurs after UE receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT requiring COMPLETE, stops T3510, resets counters, and prepares to send REGISTRATION COMPLETE.
Triggered by UE receiving a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message that does not require a REGISTRATION COMPLETE response.
Transition occurs after UE receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT not requiring COMPLETE, stops T3510, resets counters, and enters 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
Triggered by UE receiving a REGISTRATION REJECT message from the AMF.
Transition occurs after UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT, stops T3510, and processes the rejection based on the 5GMM cause value.
Triggered by UE sending the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to acknowledge reception of specific IEs in REGISTRATION ACCEPT.
Transition occurs after UE sends REGISTRATION COMPLETE; UE remains in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
Triggered by AMF receiving the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message from the UE.
Transition occurs after AMF receives REGISTRATION COMPLETE, stops timer T3550, and enters 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
Triggered by expiration of timer T3510 at the UE when the registration attempt counter is less than 5.
Transition occurs when UE restarts the initial registration procedure after T3510 timeout (implicitly includes T3511 logic).
Triggered by expiration of timer T3510 at the UE when the registration attempt counter is equal to 5.
Transition occurs when UE aborts registration after 5 attempts due to T3510 expiry, deletes context, and enters a deregistered state (e.g., 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or PLMN-SEARCH).
Triggered by abnormal cases at UE like lower layer failure, TAI change, or protocol error before receiving response.
Triggered by abnormal cases at UE like lower layer failure or TAI change after receiving ACCEPT but before sending COMPLETE.
Triggered by expiration of timer T3550 at the AMF (1st to 4th time).
Transition occurs when AMF retransmits REGISTRATION ACCEPT and restarts timer T3550.
Triggered by expiration of timer T3550 at the AMF for the 5th time.
Transition occurs when AMF aborts the procedure after 5 T3550 expiries and enters 5GMM-REGISTERED state, keeping old and new GUTIs temporarily valid.
Triggered by abnormal cases at AMF like lower layer failure before receiving REGISTRATION COMPLETE.
Transition occurs when AMF aborts the procedure due to failure and enters 5GMM-REGISTERED state, keeping old and new GUTIs temporarily valid.
